boundary: Compiler/direct/implicit Init bindings are checked by the frozen API. Only the main .olean is bound for direct external modules; external .olean.server/.olean.private companions and transitive dependencies remain part of the trusted distribution and are not claimed to have compile-time hashes in this build. A later axiom-audit environment snapshot does not retroactively supply those hashes. Comparator replay and native correspondence retain their own gates.
